data.exact_reserve_text: The 2022 result includes $1.9m of prior year reserve strengthening (0.1pps on the combined ratio). This reflects current economic conditions and the potential impact of inflation. Reserve releases reflecting reduced uncertainty surrounding Hurricane Ida and Covid-19 were largely offset by strengthening for the 2021 Texas winter storms. The 2021 comparative includes $88.9m of prior year reserve releases, reducing the combined ratio by 7.1pps (or by 5.8pps when adjusted for the distorting effect of the loss portfolio reinsurance).

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's opening gross claims reserves (31 Dec 2021) were 4,939.1 (USD millions). During 2022 there was a small prior-year reserve strengthening of $1.9m (approximately 0.04% of opening reserves). Management attributes the movement to current economic conditions and inflationary pressures, with reserve releases from reduced uncertainty around Hurricane Ida and COVID-19 largely offset by adverse development related to the 2021 Texas winter storms. The impacts are principally within property-exposed lines and other catastrophe-sensitive portfolios.

data.data_quality_notes: Amounts reported in the JSON use the native currency of the financial statements (USD) despite field names containing 'gbp'. Opening reserves taken from Statement of Financial Position (Claims outstanding, 31 Dec 2021 = 4,939.1). Prior year development amount ($1.9m strengthening) was taken from the Directors' report narrative and treated as a gross figure; the report does not provide a separate explicit gross movement table labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding'. LOB-level prior year movements are not quantified in the report; LOB directions are inferred and have low confidence. Claims development triangle is present in the report but parsing of the table columns/alignments had ambiguity in the extracted text; triangle details are therefore omitted here to avoid misalignment-consult page 46 of the report for original tables.
